about: Source-of-truth artifacts for DIUCS capacity. The artifacts win over the snapshots in docs/spec. 'snapshot_rev' is what the snapshot in this repo was taken from; compare it with the live revision before relying on a snapshot (see .claude/skills/diucs-delivery/references/sources-of-truth.md).

sources.title: DIUCS capacity: architecture and data flows
sources.authority: Hexagonal layout, ports, data flows F1-F9, security, build order. Platform decisions section overrides older PostgreSQL text.

sources.title: DIUCS capacity: FHIR R4B data model, property graph and triples
sources.authority: Resource inventory, mapping rules R1-R11, code systems, relationship catalogue, platform nodes, queries.

sources.title: DIUCS capacity: observability, session troubleshooting and product analytics
sources.authority: Event taxonomy, friction rules, funnels, privacy rules, support console.

sources.title: DIUCS SPOA Capacity: Journeys and UI
sources.authority: Every screen, its exact wording and states, and the user journeys. Screens are in project/*.dc.html; canvas.json lists the boards.

sources.title: DIUCS Capacity Sprint Plan
sources.authority: Task list, order, dependencies and task prompts. Written by Claude; the repo copy in docs/plan is the working copy.

not_a_source.title: Enterprise — Prologue
not_a_source.reason: An Azur Lane fan-fiction draft. It is not part of DIUCS. Do not read it for requirements.

derived_in_repo.note: Consolidated rule book written by Claude from the four sources. Values marked [ASSUMED] are working decisions, not spec.
Shared names, paths and signatures for the task prompts, including the Neo4j-only testing rules.
